_comment: Literature in Zambian Languages Teaching Methods -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus.
SOURCE. The manuscript "LITERATURE IN ZAMBIAN LANGUGAES SYLLABUS TED VALIDATED COPY - Mukanu Kapalang'oma" (received as a Word 97 .doc, converted to .docx with Word) holds two syllabuses: Literature
in Zambian Languages, then this Teaching Methods one. This book is built from a copy of that .docx; the first syllabus is cut
(removeRange, from its title to this one's). The Preface and Acknowledgements, written for both "syllabi", are kept.
LEVEL / YEAR. Secondary Teachers' Diploma, as the cover says; 2026 as on the cover and copyright line.
SECTION HEADS. Sections 1-7 are typed as bold lines and plain paragraphs; set as sub-section heads, as in the Content book.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix: Word list numbers; Year 2, 2.3.3 Teaching Story Composition had its competence numbered 3.3.3.1. Counted afresh from the table structure.
YEAR 2. The Year 2 row reads "YEAR TWO" against "YEAR 1"; set as YEAR 2.
ROUND 1 (Google Drive comments, 27 Oct - 16 Nov 2026; Mukanu Kapalang'oma, Mushinga K. Mooto): applied 2026-11-17, each change
with its comment in _why. The Director's name (Petronella M. Samutete (Ms)) is already the engine's.
YEAR 2 REBUILT (16 Nov, both reviewers): Teaching Poetry, Preparing to Teach and Assessment move from Year 1 to Year 2 in place
of the first School Experience; Year 1 now ends on Teaching Literary Terms. The matrix rows move (moveRow), the Scope and
Sequence entries go to the Year 2 column; renumberMatrix counts them afresh as 2.1-2.3, School Experience 2.4.
Placed from context: 'demonstrated appropriately -> done effectively' (1.11.4, the comment between the 1.11.4 and 1.11.3 ones),
'METHODS: delete' (topic 1.4, 'Teaching Methods Strategies' -> 'Teaching Strategies'), 'School Experience: Delete' in the
Scope and Sequence (the Year 1 orientation entry; its row goes, as nothing is left in it).
NOT APPLIED -- no passage highlighted and nothing to place them by (30 Oct, Kapalang'oma): 'Replace with: Teach' and 'the word
should begin with a small letter t'. Need the reviewer to say where.
